blocks.title: 📰 2. 🏛️ REGULATORY BODIES NEWS
blocks.text: 🪝 RBI Permits Commercial Banks to Lend to Registered REITs & InvITs (49% Exposure Cap). Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Commercial Banks Third Amendment Directions 2026 allows bank lending to SEBI-registered REITs.
Exposure Ceiling: Overall bank exposure to a REIT/InvIT capped at 49% of asset value; sub-limit capped at 10% of bank's capital base.
Cash Flow Mandate: Min 80% underlying assets must generate positive operational cash flows for $\\ge 1$ year.
Risk Weighting: Standard risk weight 100% (125% for capital market exposure; 150% for Indian bank overseas branches).
REIT exposure asset value cap (49%) vs capital base sub-limit (10%) vs positive cash flow requirement (80%).
